title: Host Hotels' Q3 FFO Beat Estimates on Strong RevPAR Growth
summary: HST's Q3 2026 FFO beat estimates as RevPAR rises 8.8% on strong leisure and business demand, prompting higher full-year earnings and revenue guidance.

title: Healthpeak's Q3 FFOA Beat Estimates on Leasing, Senior Housing Growth
summary: DOC's Q3 2026 FFOA and revenues beat estimates, driven by solid outpatient leasing and senior housing growth, prompting an upgraded full-year FFOA outlook.

title: SBAC Q3 FFO Top Estimates on International Leasing Gains
summary: SBA Communications' Q3 2026 FFO beat estimates, driven by strong international leasing growth, even as domestic weakness and lower site development revenues weigh on results.
